patch_description: Rewrite of the hybrid optimizer with three main improvements. (1) Proposal distribution: most moves are "bottleneck-directed" — pick a vertex of the currently smallest triangle and push it along the perpendicular away from the opposite edge (with random sign/step), which directly raises the bottleneck area, plus occasional random Gaussian moves for exploration. (2) Proper simulated annealing with adaptive step size and reheat cycles, plus a final deterministic greedy polish that sweeps small step sizes along ±x/±y and the directed perpendicular for bottleneck vertices until no improvement. (3) Robust multi-start over diverse seeds with fixed RNG seeds and a global try/except fallback to the regular 13-gon (per the recommendation: no crash-prone dead lines, gradient-free so no rescale chain-rule issues). Score is affine-invariant, so no rescaling is needed during moves. Time budget ~8s with all evaluation vectorized over the 286 triangles.
